about_the_game:
Introduction and Overview of the Game "Eternal Doom"

I. Game Introduction

"Eternal Doom" is a casual game with strategic tower defense as its core gameplay. Relying on unique level map designs and rich development elements, it creates an interesting combat experience. Players will deploy defensive units in fantastical themed scenarios such as deserts to fend off waves of enemy attacks. From basic levels to high-difficulty challenges, they gradually unlock the depth of development. Coupled with welfare systems like "Check-in" and "Tasks", it makes strategic layout and growth-oriented development complement each other, allowing players to write their own tower defense adventure chapters.

II. Game Overview

(I) Core Gameplay - Strategic Tower Defense

  • Level Combat: The maps present styles such as desert, with tortuous paths (marked by yellow dashed lines), and enemies will advance along the paths. Players need to deploy defensive units (such as defense towers of different shapes) at key points on the paths. Through attribute suppression and synthesis upgrade (the "Auto - Synthesis" function at the bottom), they build a defensive front to prevent enemies from breaking through. The attack rhythm and intensity of each wave of enemies are different, testing players' strategic planning and on-the-spot adjustment abilities.

  • Development Cycle: Gold coins and diamonds obtained from battles can be used for defense tower upgrades and unlocking new units. From strengthening basic defense towers to developing high-level special units, a "battle - resource acquisition - development - battle" loop is formed, helping players cope with more difficult levels.

(II) Featured Systems

  • Welfare Support: "Check-in" allows daily reward collection, and the "Task" system provides goal guidance and resources. Low-threshold welfare helps new players accumulate development materials and quickly get started with tower defense battles.

  • Synthesis Mechanism: The defense unit bar at the bottom supports manual or automatic synthesis. Defense towers of the same level and type can be synthesized into higher-level units, changing attributes and appearances and enriching strategic combinations - players can freely choose the tactics of "low-level quantity suppression" or "high-level quality crushing".

  • Resource Management: Gold coins are used for defense tower deployment and upgrades, and diamonds can be exchanged for rare development materials and special units. Reasonable resource allocation (such as prioritizing the strengthening of key defense towers and unlocking powerful units) is the key to passing high-difficulty levels.

(III) Interface and Growth

  • Interface Layout: The top clearly displays resources (diamonds, gold coins) and level progress; the left side integrates welfare and task entrances for convenient reward collection; the bottom is the operation area for defense units, and functions such as "Turntable" expand the gameplay dimensions. The overall hierarchy is clear and the operation is smooth.

  • Growth Path: Advance from basic levels, unlock more defense tower types and synthesis rules; accumulate resources through welfare and tasks, gradually improve the strength of defense towers, challenge higher waves and more difficult levels, unlock in-depth game content, and experience the double fun of tower defense strategy and development.

"Eternal Doom" is based on classic tower defense gameplay, integrating multiple systems such as development, welfare, and synthesis. It uses desert-themed levels to build unique combat scenarios, allowing players to feel the charm of tower defense games in strategic layout and resource games, continuously break through levels, and unlock more challenging adventures!
